proposal_types.description: Technical & Commercial Proposal for Honeywell procurement.
proposal_types.cover_letter:
We are pleased to submit this Technical & Commercial Proposal in response to your procurement requirement. This master template is designed for an AI Procurement Proposal Generation System. The AI retrieves information from Proposal, SPR, Registration, Purchase Order and Tender documents and automatically fills the proposal. Any field unavailable in the uploaded documents is intentionally marked as NA for manual completion before submission.

We confirm our commitment to quality, compliance, timely delivery and customer satisfaction. The final proposal generated by the AI system will include technical, commercial and procurement information retrieved from authorised documents only. We appreciate the opportunity to participate in this procurement process and look forward to your favourable response.

extensibility_note: To add a new proposal type: (1) add a folder under templates/<new_type>/ with its .docx template, (2) append a new object here, (3) add a matching entry to field_mapping.json's 'proposal_types'. No Python code changes are required.
